name: Plex Showtime
description: Native Plex media display for LEDMatrix with reliable TV episode metadata, measured text layout, and persistent scrolling sessions for long movie, show, and episode text.
author: airbornetrooper82573

versions.notes: Fix scrolling lifecycle under LEDMatrix repeated display dispatches by keeping one persistent animation session per displayed item
Use an independent TV episode scroll trigger and measured font geometry for movie/media rows to prevent subtitle clipping
Integrate with LEDMatrix scrolling state, add configurable 85% scroll trigger threshold, and log measured text widths
Add independent scrolling for long TV show and episode-name rows; fix subtitle clipping using measured font bounds
Query TV library sections directly for real episode objects sorted by addedAt so Recently Added reliably displays both show and episode names
Use canonical ratingKey metadata paths for Recently Added TV, try multiple episode endpoints, and skip unresolved season containers instead of displaying Season N
Fix Plex show/season key normalization so Recently Added TV resolves to the newest episode and retains the series name
Automatically scroll oversized media titles with configurable speed, pause, gap, and FPS
Resolve Recently Added TV show/season containers to their newest episode so both series and episode names display reliably
Show both series name and episode title for Recently Added TV episodes
Add configurable show-level duplicate suppression for Recently Added episodes
Add separate Recently Added show/episode limits and independent Recently Played movie/TV/music limits
Add independent Recently Added limits for movies, TV, and music
Robust recursive Plex XML parsing, header-based authentication, and source diagnostics
Fix BasePlugin layout property collision that prevented plugin startup
Add ultra-wide 320x32 marquee layout and panel-aware display options
